name: Repo should be associated with an approved CI/CD app
description: Code repo should be attached to an authorized CI/CD application.
detailedDescription: By bypassing the authorized CI/CD application (either by using shadow CI/CD or manual building) guardrails, tests and additional checks may not be performed on code changes. This may result in significantly degraded security.
